pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal and sub-rectangular patches with relatively smooth edge gradients and rounded vertices. Patch size increases significantly from the cervical region toward the mid-flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored pathways forming a topological grid. Junction nodes predominantly exhibit triradiate and tetraradiate intersections with consistent pixel thickness across the flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Mane along the upper neck and shoulder presents a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette with a dense, fine-textured pixel density.
